---
title: "PlayerTargets"
author: "Georgia Scott"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---


Colour scheme can be changed, numbers and colours:
80% > Green
60% > Light Blue
60% < Amber
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(hms)
library(readxl)
library(condformat)
setwd("DataLocation")

squad<-read_xlsx("SquadList202627.xlsx",sheet=1)
squad$PositionGroup2 <- ifelse(squad$Position %in% c("Prop", "Hooker"), "FR",
                               ifelse(squad$Position %in% c("Second Row"), "SR",
                                      ifelse(squad$Position %in% c("Back Row"), "BR",
                                             ifelse(squad$Position %in% c("Scrum Half", "Out Half"), "HB",
                                                    ifelse(squad$Position %in% c( "Back Three"), "OB",
                                                           ifelse(squad$Position %in% c("Centre"),"CC",""))))))

round_mean <- function(x) {
  round(mean(x), digits = 0) 
}

round_mean2 <- function(x) {
  round(mean(x), digits = 1)  
}
datadump<-suppressWarnings(read_xlsx("GPS - Database - Heart Rate.xlsx",sheet=1))
sched<-read.csv("Schedule.csv")
sched$active_days<- as.Date(sched$active_days, format = "%d/%m/%Y")
datadump$`Total Time`<-as.numeric(as_hms(datadump$`Total Time`))/60
datadump$`Session Date`<-as.Date(datadump$`Session Date`)
datadump$`Total Distance`<-round(datadump$`Total Distance`,digits=0)
datadump$`Player Position` <- factor(datadump$`Player Position`, levels = c("Prop","Hooker","Second Row","Back Row","Scrum Half","Out Half","Centre","Back Three"))

datadump$PositionGroup<-ifelse(datadump$`Player Position` %in% c("Prop","Hooker","Back Row","Second Row"),"Forward","Back")
colnames(datadump)[colnames(datadump) == "Total Distance"] <- "Total Distance"
colnames(datadump)[colnames(datadump) == "Player Name"] <- "Name"
colnames(datadump)[colnames(datadump) == "HML Distance"] <- "HMLD"
colnames(datadump)[colnames(datadump) == "Position"] <- "Position2"
colnames(datadump)[colnames(datadump) == "Player Position"] <- "Position"
colnames(datadump)[colnames(datadump) == "High Speed Running (Relative)"] <- "VHSR >70%"
colnames(datadump)[colnames(datadump) == "Accelerations"] <- "Accels"
colnames(datadump)[colnames(datadump) == "% Accel GD"] <- "Accels old"
colnames(datadump)[colnames(datadump) == "Accels GD"] <- "Accels old2"
colnames(datadump)[colnames(datadump) == "VHSR GD"] <- "VHSR old2"
colnames(datadump)[colnames(datadump) == "% VHSR GD"] <- "VHSR old"

datadump$PositionGroup2 <- ifelse(datadump$Position %in% c("Prop", "Hooker"), "FR",
                               ifelse(datadump$Position %in% c("Second Row"), "SR",
                                      ifelse(datadump$Position %in% c("Back Row"), "BR",
                                             ifelse(datadump$Position %in% c("Scrum Half", "Out Half"), "HB",
                                                    ifelse(datadump$Position %in% c( "Back Three"), "OB",
                                                           ifelse(datadump$Position %in% c("Centre"),"CC",""))))))

datadump$MMin<-round(datadump$`Total Distance`/datadump$`Total Time`,digits=1)
datadump$HMLMin<-round(datadump$`HMLD`/datadump$`Total Time`,digits=1)
datadump$AccelMin<-round(datadump$Accels/datadump$`Total Time`,digits=1)
datadump$VHSRMin<-round(datadump$`VHSR >70%`/datadump$`Total Time`,digits=1)
datadump$Initials <- sapply(strsplit(datadump$Name, " "), function(x) paste0(substr(x, 1, 1), collapse = ""))
datadump$`VHSR >70%`<-round(datadump$`VHSR >70%`,digits=0)
datadump$HMLD<-round(datadump$HMLD,digits=0)
datadump<-subset(datadump,datadump$Season=="2025/26")
datadump <- merge(datadump, sched, by.x = "Session Date", by.y = "active_days", all.x = TRUE)
training<-subset(datadump,grepl(Sys.Date(),datadump$`Session Date`))

trainingtotal<-subset(training,training$`Drill Title`=="Rugby - Full Session"|training$`Drill Title`=="Rugby - Extras")
trainingtotalweek<-subset(datadump,datadump$`Drill Title`=="Rugby - Full Session"|datadump$`Drill Title`=="Rugby - Extras")

load<-read.csv("LoadPlanningInReport.csv") ## load planner data
load<-load[,-1]

```
### Weekly Targets Totals ####
```{r, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE, out.width="125%",out.height="125%"}
week<- subset(load,load$Week == load$Week[load$Date == Sys.Date()])
target_week <- unique(week$Week)
if (length(target_week) == 1) {
  sofar <- trainingtotalweek[trainingtotalweek$`Session Week Number` == target_week, ]
} else {
  warning("Date matched multiple or no week numbers.")
}
sofar<-sofar[c("Name", "HMLD","VHSR >70%","PositionGroup2")]
sofar<-sofar%>%
  group_by(Name,PositionGroup2)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(HMLD=sum(HMLD),VHSR=sum(`VHSR >70%`), .groups = "drop")

hmldbefore <- week[week$Date <= Sys.Date(), ]

hmldweekneededsofar<-hmldbefore %>%
  group_by(Position) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(HMLDneeded=sum(HMLD),VHSRneeded=sum(VHSR))

playersleft<-merge(hmldweekneededsofar,sofar,by.x="Position",by.y = "PositionGroup2")
playersleft$differenceHMLD<-playersleft$HMLDneeded-playersleft$HMLD
playersleft$differenceVHSR<-playersleft$VHSRneeded-playersleft$VHSR

daysafter <- length(unique(week$Date[week$Date >= Sys.Date() & week$HMLD != 0]))
playersleft$differenceperdayHMLD<-playersleft$differenceHMLD/daysafter
playersleft$differenceperdayVHSR<-playersleft$differenceVHSR/daysafter
weeklylloads<- week %>%
  group_by(Position)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(hmldsum=sum(HMLD)+900,vhsr=sum(VHSR)) ### add 900 here
playerleftweek<-merge(playersleft,weeklylloads,by="Position")
playerleftweek<-playerleftweek[,c(4,1,5,6,2,3,11,12)]
colnames(playerleftweek)<-c("Name","Position","HMLD So Far","VHSR So Far","HMLD Target So Far","VHSR Target So Far","HMLD Target Week","VHSR Target Week")
playerleftweek$`% of HMLD So Far`<-playerleftweek$`HMLD So Far`/playerleftweek$`HMLD Target So Far`
playerleftweek$`% of VHSR So Far`<-playerleftweek$`VHSR So Far`/playerleftweek$`VHSR Target So Far`
playerleftweek$`% of HMLD Week`<-playerleftweek$`HMLD So Far`/(playerleftweek$`HMLD Target Week`+900)### add 900 here
playerleftweek$`% of VHSR Week`<-playerleftweek$`VHSR So Far`/playerleftweek$`VHSR Target Week`
playerleftweek$Position <- factor(playerleftweek$Position, levels = c("FR","SR","BR","HB","CC","OB"))
playerleftweek <- playerleftweek[order(playerleftweek$Position), ]
playerleftweek$Initials <- sapply(strsplit(playerleftweek$Name, " "), function(x) paste0(substr(x, 1, 1), collapse = ""))


playerleftweek <- playerleftweek %>%
  mutate(
    HMLD_Color = case_when(
      `% of HMLD Week` > 0.85 ~ "darkgreen",
      `% of HMLD Week` >= 0.60 ~ "lightblue",
      TRUE ~ "orange"
    ),
    NameFactorHMLD = as.factor(Name)  # for legend control
  )

playerleftweek <- playerleftweek %>%
  mutate(
    VHSR_Color = case_when(
      `% of VHSR Week` > 0.85 ~ "darkgreen",
      `% of VHSR Week` >= 0.60 ~ "lightblue",
      TRUE ~ "orange"
    ),
    NameFactorVHSR = as.factor(Name)  # for legend control
  )
a <- ggplot(playerleftweek, aes(x = Position, y = `HMLD Target Week`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", position = "dodge", fun = round_mean, fill = "black") +
  
  # Map legend color to Name (not performance), but text color to performance
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Initials, color = NameFactorHMLD), 
    vjust = -0.5,
    y = playerleftweek$`HMLD So Far`,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  
  # Assign colors manually based on HMLD_Color
  scale_color_manual(
    values = setNames(playerleftweek$HMLD_Color, playerleftweek$NameFactorHMLD)
  ) +
  
  xlab("") +coord_cartesian(
  ylim=c(min(min(playerleftweek$`HMLD So Far`), min(playerleftweek$`HMLD Target Week`)),max(max(playerleftweek$`HMLD So Far`), max(playerleftweek$`HMLD Target Week`))))+
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

b1 <- ggplotly(a, tooltip = c("Name", "Position", "HMLD Target Week","HMLD So Far")) %>%
  layout(legend = list(title = list(text = NULL)),
         hovermode = "closest",
         hoverlabel = list(font = list(color = "white")),
         pointmeta = list(text = "HMLD Target Week"))

a <- ggplot(playerleftweek, aes(x = Position, y = `VHSR Target Week`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", position = "dodge", fun = round_mean, fill = "black") +
  
  # Map legend color to Name (not performance), but text color to performance
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Initials, color = NameFactorVHSR), 
    vjust = -0.5,
    y = playerleftweek$`VHSR So Far`,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  
  # Assign colors manually based on HMLD_Color
  scale_color_manual(
    values = setNames(playerleftweek$VHSR_Color, playerleftweek$NameFactorVHSR)
  ) +
  
  xlab("") +coord_cartesian(
  ylim=c(min(min(playerleftweek$`VHSR So Far`), min(playerleftweek$`VHSR Target Week`)),max(max(playerleftweek$`VHSR So Far`), max(playerleftweek$`VHSR Target Week`))))+

  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

b2 <- ggplotly(a, tooltip = c("Name", "Position", "VHSR Target Week","VHSR So Far")) %>%
  layout(legend = list(title = list(text = NULL)),
         hovermode = "closest",
         hoverlabel = list(font = list(color = "white")),
         pointmeta = list(text = "VHSR Target Week"))

# Combine the plots into a single Plotly object
combined_plotsg <- subplot(b1,b2, nrows=1, shareX = FALSE, shareY = FALSE,titleY = TRUE,margin=0.05)

# Customize legend settings
combined_plotsg <- combined_plotsg %>% layout(
  legend = list(
    traceorder = "normal",  # Ensure the order of legend items is consistent
    font = list(color = "black"),  # Customize legend font color
    bgcolor = "white",  # Set legend background color
    bordercolor = "white",  # Set legend border color
    borderwidth = 1  # Set legend border width
  )
)

# Display the combined plot for session compared to game 
combined_plotsg
```

### Daily Target ####

Daily targets columns are averaged on position, as these will change day to day unlike the specific targets for the week. 
```{r, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE, out.width="125%",out.height="125%"}
setwd("targetsheetlocation")
todaysthresholds<-read_xlsx(paste0("Import Template ",Sys.Date(),".xlsx"),sheet=1)
trainingtotalsum<-trainingtotal %>%
  group_by(Name)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(HMLD=sum(HMLD),`VHSR >70%`=sum(`VHSR >70%`),Position=Position)
trainingtotalsum<-unique(trainingtotalsum)
trainingtotalsum$Initials <- sapply(strsplit(trainingtotalsum$Name, " "), function(x) paste0(substr(x, 1, 1), collapse = ""))
todaysthresholds<-merge(trainingtotalsum,todaysthresholds,by.x = "Name",by.y = "Player")

todaysthresholds$`% of HMLD Today`<-todaysthresholds$HMLD/todaysthresholds$`hml distance`
todaysthresholds$`% of VHSR Today`<-todaysthresholds$`VHSR >70%`/todaysthresholds$`high speed running (relative)`
colnames(todaysthresholds)[colnames(todaysthresholds) == "hml distance"] <- "HMLD Daily Target"
colnames(todaysthresholds)[colnames(todaysthresholds) == "high speed running (relative)"] <- "VHSR Daily Target"


todaysthresholds <- todaysthresholds %>%
  mutate(
    HMLD_Color = case_when(
      `% of HMLD Today` > 0.85 ~ "darkgreen",
      `% of HMLD Today` >= 0.60 ~ "lightblue",
      TRUE ~ "orange"
    ),
    NameFactorHMLD = as.factor(Name)  # for legend control
  )

todaysthresholds <- todaysthresholds %>%
  mutate(
    VHSR_Color = case_when(
      `% of VHSR Today` > 0.85 ~ "darkgreen",
      `% of VHSR Today` >= 0.60 ~ "lightblue",
      TRUE ~ "orange"
    ),
    NameFactorVHSR = as.factor(Name)  # for legend control
  )
a <- ggplot(todaysthresholds, aes(x = Position, y = `HMLD Daily Target`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", position = "dodge", fun = round_mean, fill = "black") +
  
  # Map legend color to Name (not performance), but text color to performance
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Initials, color = NameFactorHMLD), 
    vjust = -0.5,
    y = todaysthresholds$HMLD,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  
  # Assign colors manually based on HMLD_Color
  scale_color_manual(
    values = setNames(todaysthresholds$HMLD_Color, todaysthresholds$NameFactorHMLD)
  ) +
  
  xlab("") +coord_cartesian(
    ylim=c(min(min(todaysthresholds$`HMLD`), min(todaysthresholds$`HMLD Daily Target`)), max(max(todaysthresholds$`HMLD`), max(todaysthresholds$`HMLD Daily Target`))))+
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    text = element_text(size = 16)
  )
b1 <- ggplotly(a, tooltip = c("Name", "Position", "HMLD Daily Target","HMLD So Far")) %>%
  layout(legend = list(title = list(text = NULL)),
         hovermode = "closest",
         hoverlabel = list(font = list(color = "white")),
         pointmeta = list(text = "HMLD Daily Target"))


a <- ggplot(todaysthresholds, aes(x = Position, y = `VHSR Daily Target`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", position = "dodge", fun = round_mean, fill = "black") +
  
  # Map legend color to Name (not performance), but text color to performance
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Initials, color = NameFactorVHSR), 
    vjust = -0.5,
    y = todaysthresholds$`VHSR >70%`,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  
  # Assign colors manually based on HMLD_Color
  scale_color_manual(
    values = setNames(todaysthresholds$VHSR_Color, todaysthresholds$NameFactorVHSR)
  ) +
  
  xlab("") +coord_cartesian(
    ylim=c(min(min(todaysthresholds$`VHSR`), min(todaysthresholds$`VHSR Daily Target`)), max(max(todaysthresholds$`VHSR >70%`), max(todaysthresholds$`VHSR Daily Target`))))+
  
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    text = element_text(size = 16)
  )
b2 <- ggplotly(a, tooltip = c("Name", "Position", "VHSR Daily Target","VHSR So Far")) %>%
  layout(legend = list(title = list(text = NULL)),
         hovermode = "closest",
         hoverlabel = list(font = list(color = "white")),
         pointmeta = list(text = "VHSR Daily Target"))
# Combine the plots into a single Plotly object
combined_plotsg <- subplot(b1,b2, nrows=1, shareX = FALSE, shareY = FALSE,titleY = TRUE,margin=0.05)

# Customize legend settings
combined_plotsg <- combined_plotsg %>% layout(
  legend = list(
    traceorder = "normal",  # Ensure the order of legend items is consistent
    font = list(color = "black"),  # Customize legend font color
    bgcolor = "white",  # Set legend background color
    bordercolor = "white",  # Set legend border color
    borderwidth = 1  # Set legend border width
  )
)

# Display the combined plot for session compared to game 
combined_plotsg

weeklylloads<- week %>%
  group_by(Position)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(hmldsum=sum(HMLD)+900,vhsr=sum(VHSR)) ### add 900
playersleftweek<-merge(playersleft,weeklylloads,by.x = "Position",by.y = "Position")
playersleftweek<-playersleftweek[,c(4,1,5,6,2,3,11,12)]

colnames(playersleftweek)<-c("Name","Position","HMLD So Far","VHSR So Far","HMLD Target So Far","VHSR Target So Far","HMLD Target Week","VHSR Target Week")
playersleftweek$`% of HMLD So Far`<-round(playersleftweek$`HMLD So Far`/(playersleftweek$`HMLD Target So Far`),digits=2)
playersleftweek$`% of VHSR So Far`<-round(playersleftweek$`VHSR So Far`/playersleftweek$`VHSR Target So Far`,digits=2)
playersleftweek$`% of HMLD Week`<-round(playersleftweek$`HMLD So Far`/(playersleftweek$`HMLD Target Week`)+900,digits=2) ### add 900
playersleftweek$`% of VHSR Week`<-round(playersleftweek$`VHSR So Far`/playersleftweek$`VHSR Target Week`,digits=2)
playersleftweek$`HMLD Target Week`<-playersleftweek$`HMLD Target Week`
playersleftweek$Position <- factor(playersleftweek$Position, levels = c("FR","SR","BR","HB","CC","OB"))
playersleftweek <- playersleftweek[order(playersleftweek$Position), ]
setwd("Outputlocationforanalysisoftargets")
write.csv(playersleftweek, paste0("MidweekTotal ",format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d"), ".csv"))
```
